title: The ‘left brain took over’ theory goes viral
summary:
The spiciest throughline: Malcolm Ocean keeps insisting McGilchrist isn’t doing the cringe “left brain math / right brain art” thing—he’s saying your *attention* literally builds your world, and the left hemisphere is uniquely prone to thinking its simplified model is the whole truth. Ocean’s canonical 2020 thread on *Ways of Attending* turns that into a meme-able diagnosis: LH narrows, categorizes, controls; RH holds context, ambiguity, “betweenness,” empathy. The hook quote that powers half the discourse is basically: the LH has “language, logic, linearity” and can “propagandize and delegitimize the RH’s perspective,” so it’s like “the Berlusconi of the brain” and we’re culturally becoming prisoners of it.

The arc: in 2019 Ocean builds a meta-thread as a distribution machine (“here’s 100 things it reminds me of”), then he drops the big AI take in Oct 2019—current chatbots are “basically left hemispheres,” i.e., they confabulate and don’t admit confusion (riffing on Janelle Shane). May 2020 is the peak: Ocean writes the long intro thread summarizing McGilchrist and the “Master and his Emissary” fable, then follows with the darker “what if LH becomes the sole purveyor of reality?” checklist (siloing, credentials over experience, cynicism, paranoia/control politics, intolerance for ambiguity). After that the energy shifts from “here’s the model” to “what do we *do* with it?”—and that’s where m_ashcroft blows it open in 2021 by claiming Alexander Technique might be a “system level solution” for returning power from Emissary to Master, plus the extremely relatable practitioner claim: AT makes the world feel “depth, fluidity and vibrancy” again.

By 2022–2024 it’s fully colonized adjacent internet territories: Yash Kaf says modern dating is broken because people are trying to date in a “LEFT-BRAINED way”; m_ashcroft offers a clean definition of “woo” as “experiences that cannot be articulated by the part of the mind that can only understand experiences by articulating them”; and the_wilderless does the defensive cleanup work, posting McGilchrist’s “20 robust differences” list to fend off the kneejerk “debunked!” crowd. The whole thing matters because it’s become a shared vocabulary for criticizing modern life (bureaucracy, tech, discourse) *and* for pointing at a pragmatic escape hatch (somatic/attention training)—and once you’re “hemisphere-pilled,” people start diagnosing everything from AI alignment to romance to spirituality with it.
